_comment: Maps snip categories (the directory name under snips/{junos,evo}/) to a Technology family for the 'Technology' browse mode. One semantic override lives in generate-snips.mjs: EVPN snips authored under transport/ are re-homed to 'Service Overlay'. Subfamily (2nd level) is derived per-snip from filename keywords, family-aware, in generate-snips.mjs.
